content: The frequency at which individuals with diabetes will need COVID-19 booster vaccinations remains uncertain at this time. While there is limited information regarding the attitudes toward or the uptake of COVID-19 vaccines among people with diabetes in the United States, healthcare providers who specialize in diabetes management are uniquely positioned to address any questions or concerns these patients may have about vaccination. These specialists hold a critical role in encouraging vaccination among diabetic patients to reduce the potential risks and complications associated with COVID-19 infections.
